definitions.J: max adjacent-observed stock increase at hours 72..215 >= 0.01; hour 71 is eligible prior
definitions.any_positive: At least one observed forecast stock > 0
definitions.S_and_J: Intersection of S and J, one county-event per row
definitions.all_observed_zero: All observed forecast stocks zero and at least one observed hour; missing hours are unknown
definitions.nonS: All observed forecast stocks below 0.10 and at least one observed hour
definitions.primary_metric: sqrt(sum_i w_i SSE_i / sum_i w_i N_i), all observed hours 72..215 in selected units
definitions.improvement: 1 - candidate RMSE / host RMSE; +0.10 means 10% lower RMSE
definitions.horizons: Fixed-origin snapshots: +h is column h-1, panel hour 71+h; no shift or rolling reforecast
definitions.interval_scope: Paired bootstrap of frozen OOF errors; conditional on observed cohorts and fitted models, not refit/seed uncertainty
definitions.bootstrap_strata: Each whole cluster assigned to largest full-D clipped design unit weight mass regime; ties follow REGIMES order
definitions.selection_limit: Outcome-defined evaluation subsets; not a prospective affected-county detector or causal estimand
